title: v137.9.7: Add Atomic Signal Transduction Observatory (Layer-4 observability)
body: ### Motivation - Introduce a deterministic, replay-safe Layer-4 observability consumer that derives stable observation windows and transduction summaries from replay-certified lineage without modifying prior layers. - Provide additive, deterministic artifacts and APIs that map observatory identity to replay certification bytes to satisfy the required lineage chain and invariants. ### Description - Added new module `src/qec/analysis/atomic_signal_transduction_observatory.py` implementing the observatory for v137.9.7, with canonical JSON/bytes serialization, SHA-256 stable hashing, and strict finite-float validation. - Implemented frozen dataclasses with required methods: `AtomicSignalObservation`, `AtomicSignalWindow`, `AtomicSignalTransductionObservatoryResult`, and `AtomicSignalObservatoryReceipt`, each supporting `to_dict()`, `to_canonical_json()`, `to_canonical_bytes()`, and `stable_hash()`. - Implemented deterministic APIs: `run_atomic_signal_transduction_observatory(...)`, `export_atomic_signal_observatory_bytes(...)`, and `generate_atomic_signal_observatory_receipt(...)`, including non-invasive direct-lineage validation hooks for optional artifacts (`RFEqualizationResult`, `SatelliteBaselineResult`, `TelecomRecoveryResult`, `SpectralReasoningResult`, `MultimodalFeatureSchemaResult`). - Enforced required invariants and deterministic ordering rules: `ATOMIC_SIGNAL_TRANSDUCTION_OBSERVATORY_LAW`, `DETERMINISTIC_OBSERVATORY_ORDERING_RULE`, `REPLAY_SAFE_OBSERVATORY_IDENTITY_RULE`, and `BOUNDED_OBSERVATORY_SCORE_RULE`; implemented bounded deterministic scores in `[0.0, 1.0]` and fail-fast checks for malformed upstream input. - `AtomicSignalObservation.observatory_profile` is now always consistent with the top-level result `observatory_profile` (previously diverged when profile was `"end_to_end_signal_window"`). - `_validate_replay_certification_artifact` now cross-checks top-level `source_*` fields against `ledger.lineage_chain` and each witness's `lineage_chain`, closing a forged-provenance vector where a caller could mutate `source_*` fields, recompute `replay_certification_hash`, and pass all prior hash-consistency checks while carrying incorrect upstream lineage. - `score_fixture` is documented as a deterministic-readiness validation parameter only; it is validated for finiteness but is not incorporated into any observatory score computation. ### Testing - Ran focused pytest suites and verified success: `pytest -q tests/test_atomic_signal_transduction_observatory.py` (11 passed) and `pytest -q tests/test_cross_modal_replay_certification.py` (10 passed). - Tests cover byte-identical artifacts for identical input, deterministic repeated runs, stable observation/window ordering, stable hash invariants, fail-fast malformed upstream input, lineage preservation, receipt determinism, bounded score checks, NaN/infinity rejection, direct-lineage mismatch rejection, and forged `source_*` field rejection. - `_lineage_artifacts` converted to a `@pytest.fixture(scope="module")` so the full upstream pipeline is built once per test module. ------ Codex Task
